essence: Observing the rite for seven solar days makes one directly equal to Bṛhaspati.
On Sunday one should write the mantra in milk-rice with a gold stylus.
One may hear the meaning in a dream and should remember the seed-syllable oneself in the morning.
The mantra consists of the sequence tāra, vāghrīṃ, ramā, kāma, tāra, maṃ, maṇikarṇike.
The mantra's sage is Vyāsa, its metre is atiśakvarī, and its deity is Maṇikarṇikā.
